about_title: Take Control of Your Digital Life
about_subtitle: The next-generation open-source security engine built by an independent developer and AI.
about_p1: DewSecure was born from a simple vision: to return control of the internet to the user. We believe you should decide what content you see, not advertisers and pervasive trackers.
about_p2: This is more than an interception tool; it's a privacy sandbox deeply integrating device-side AI and cloud federated learning. With 110,000+ precise rules and a 3-class AI model dual-engine, we purify your network environment in milliseconds.
about_p3: As a fully open-source software (Open Core), DewSecure's core engine code is open to scrutiny by global developers. We refuse to sell user data or engage in black-box operations.
trans_home_desc: The web is dynamic and tracking technologies keep evolving, so we cannot guarantee a 100% block rate. However, DewSecure evolves continuously through AI to provide you with the strongest filtering experience possible.
trans_about_p1: 1. Technical & Platform Limitations: We cannot achieve a 100% interception rate across all platforms.
trans_about_p2: 2. Dynamic Web Environment: We cannot guarantee that the tool will permanently block all future evasion techniques.
trans_about_p3: 3. Commitment to Continuous Evolution: Our AI models iterate automatically every week.

faq_1_q: What is the core difference between Free and Pro?
faq_1_a: Free provides full DNR rule blocking and anti-tracking features. Pro unlocks AI model cloud OTA updates, local on-device AI detection (anti-phishing/anti-mining), and cross-device cloud sync for whitelists.
faq_2_q: What happens after the trial ends? Will I be charged automatically?
faq_2_a: No. You get a 30-day Pro trial upon registration without auto-billing. You must manually subscribe via the pricing page. If you don't, the system automatically downgrades you to Free.
faq_3_q: What payment methods are supported? Is it secure?
faq_3_a: All payments are processed by Stripe. We support Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We never store your credit card info.
faq_4_q: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq_4_a: Yes. We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied within 14 days of purchase, contact support for a full refund.
faq_5_q: Will I lose Pro features immediately if I cancel?
faq_5_a: No. Your benefits remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. After that, you will be downgraded to Free automatically without any hidden charges.
faq_6_q: Should I choose Pro or Family?
faq_6_a: Pro is for individuals (up to 3 devices like PC + Phone + Tablet). Family is for sharing with up to 9 devices. You can invite family members via email in the Dashboard.
faq_7_q: Do invited family members need to pay?
faq_7_a: No. Sub-accounts share the main account's subscription and expiry date. If the main account cancels or expires, all sub-accounts will also be downgraded to Free.
faq_8_q: Can I leave the family group or change members?
faq_8_a: Absolutely. The main account can remove members or unbind devices anytime in the Dashboard. Removed members immediately downgrade to Free.
faq_9_q: How does the 'Invite friends for 120 days Pro' reward work?
faq_9_a: When a friend registers via your link and completes their first real payment, after a 14-day cooling-off period (anti-fraud), 120 days of Pro will be automatically added to your account.
faq_10_a: Yes! Anyone can download and use it for free. If you register and log in, you get a free 30-day Pro trial.
faq_11_a: Absolutely not. DewSecure uses an Open Core model audited globally. All matching and AI inference happen locally. We never collect your browsing history or upload URLs.
faq_12_q: Why can't some YouTube ads be blocked?
faq_12_a: DewSecure respects the YouTube creator ecosystem. We do not block creator-revenue ads by default.
faq_13_a: Chrome and Edge on the same PC count as 2 devices. Android + PC count as 2 devices. You can unbind old devices in the Dashboard to free up slots.
faq_14_a: Some sites integrate ads deeply with content (same-origin). Blocking them breaks the layout. We prioritize usability. Also, our AI models update weekly to kill new ads.
faq_15_a: Yes, strong blocking is on by default. Tip: If a legitimate pop-up is blocked (like a login window), add the domain to your Whitelist in the extension panel.
faq_16_a: Yes. It's called 'Malvertising'. Hackers buy ad slots to spread trojans. DewSecure cuts off requests to these malicious networks at the root.
faq_17_q: Can DewSecure stop websites from stealing my CPU for crypto mining?
faq_17_a: Yes, very effectively. Pro uses on-device AI to detect and block silent mining scripts, saving your CPU and battery.

faq_18_q: Why does the page delay showing 'Pro' after successful payment?
faq_18_a: Because payment confirmation is cross-system. The system waits 2.5 seconds to ensure Stripe Webhook has fully saved the benefits to the database before rendering, ensuring 100% data accuracy.
faq_19_q: What happens to my remaining trial days if I upgrade?
faq_19_a: Remaining trial days are automatically added after the new 365 days (e.g., 20 days left + 1 year = 385 days). You won't lose days or be charged extra.
faq_20_q: Will clicking purchase again or refreshing create double billing?
faq_20_a: Absolutely not. The backend has a strict 'active subscription interception' mechanism. It will block and redirect you to the dashboard, preventing double subscriptions.
faq_21_q: What happens if a Family sub-account buys an independent Pro?
faq_21_a: The system will prompt that you will leave the family group. After payment, you become an independent Pro account, and your device slot in the original family group is freed.
faq_22_q: Will my account be deactivated immediately if I request a refund within 14 days?
faq_22_a: Yes. Upon successful refund, the Webhook immediately downgrades your account to Free and clears remaining days. If you are a family owner, the family group will also be dissolved.
faq_23_q: What happens to my 120-day reward if my invited friend refunds immediately?
faq_23_a: 1. Your 120-day reward is voided; 2. Your successful invite count is automatically reduced by 1.
faq_24_q: What if the reward is already issued after 14 days and the friend then refunds?
faq_24_a: If this happens, days already in your balance pool won't be deducted, but the refunded account will still be downgraded. The 14-day lock is designed to protect your interests.
faq_25_q: Why can't I find the 'Renew' button when my subscription is about to expire?
faq_25_a: Because Stripe auto-renews. On the expiry date, it automatically charges and adds 365 days. The renew button only reappears after you click 'Cancel Subscription' and it expires.
faq_26_q: Why do I still have Pro features after clicking 'Cancel Subscription'?
faq_26_a: Cancellation only stops next year's auto-renewal. Your remaining purchased days are still valid until the expiration date.
faq_27_q: Will clicking 'Manage Subscription' to the Stripe page charge me?
faq_27_a: No. This is Stripe's official self-service portal. You can safely update cards, download invoices, or upgrade to Family with prorated pricing calculated transparently by Stripe.
faq_28_q: What to do if cross-device login says 'Token expired' or the extension won't sync?
faq_28_a: Login sessions typically last 1 hour. The website silently pushes the latest Token to the extension instantly. If it fails, ensure you are logged in on the website and refresh the extension.
privacy_intro_1: DewSecure is built on one architectural principle: data stays on your device, and anything that can be processed locally is never sent over the network. We do not sell your data, we do not use your browsing history for advertising profiles, and we do not share any personally identifiable information with third parties for their independent marketing.
privacy_intro_2: This Privacy Policy applies to your use of the DewSecure browser extension (for Chrome, Edge, Opera, and Yandex Browser based on the Chromium engine, as well as Firefox and other mainstream browsers based on the Gecko engine), the official website (dewsecure.com), the cloud authentication and model distribution services (Cloudflare Worker), and the subscription management services (Supabase + Stripe).
privacy_s1_p1: DewSecure is operated by an independent developer. If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact us at dewsecure9@gmail.com.
privacy_s2_21_h: 2.1 Account and Subscription Data (only when logging in or paying)
privacy_s2_21_p1: Email address: used for OTP login, subscription status sync, renewal reminders, and refund notifications.
privacy_s2_21_p2: Subscription status: plan tier (Free / Pro / Family), expiration date, auto-renewal cancellation status, and referral credit balance.
privacy_s2_21_p3: Device slot information: the installation_id silently reported by the extension, along with browser and operating system type, used solely to display slots in use on your Dashboard and to allow one-click unbinding.
privacy_s2_22_p1: Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store or have access to your full card number; Stripe only returns subscription status, amount, currency, payment time, and Customer ID to us. Stripe's own privacy practices are governed by its privacy policy.
privacy_s2_23_h: 2.3 Extension-Side Local Data (never leaves your device)
privacy_s2_23_p1: URL and page content analysis: performed entirely within your browser's local sandbox, never uploaded to any server.
privacy_s2_23_p2: AI model inference: model files are securely delivered via Cloudflare Worker + R2 (with SHA-256 verification and token authentication), and inference runs entirely on-device.
privacy_s2_23_p3: Rule matching: 110,405 DNR rules take effect locally, with no network callbacks.
privacy_s2_23_p4: Block statistics: block counts are stored in the extension's local storage and are never uploaded.
privacy_s2_23_p5: The extension does not collect your browsing history, page content, form data, input records, or any browsing behavior that could identify you personally.
privacy_s2_24_p1: When you visit dewsecure.com, our servers (Cloudflare) process standard request metadata: anonymized IP, request timestamp, browser type and version, operating system name and version, requested URL, and referrer URL. This data is used only for security protection and basic operations, never for advertising or user profiling.
privacy_s3_p1: We use data for account login and verification, subscription status sync and family group management, payment and refund processing, device slot limits and one-click unbinding, abuse and free-riding prevention (device fingerprint locks, disposable email blacklists), and referral credit settlement. All of these uses are necessary for operating the service.
privacy_s4_p1: We do not sell your personal data. Necessary information is shared with third parties only in the following scenarios:
privacy_s4_p2: Stripe: processes payments and subscription management; receives your email and subscription metadata.
privacy_s4_p3: Supabase: stores account and subscription records; data resides in its hosting region.
privacy_s4_p4: Cloudflare: provides Worker authentication, R2 model distribution, and website hosting.
privacy_s4_p5: Legal requirements: disclosure only in response to valid legal process, and we will notify you in advance to the extent permitted by law.
privacy_s5_p1: Account data: deleted when you actively delete your account or after 24 consecutive months of inactivity.
privacy_s5_p2: Subscription and payment records: retained as required by tax and accounting regulations (typically 7 years).
privacy_s5_p3: Block statistics and device slots: primarily stored locally, no longer retained after unbinding or uninstalling the extension.
privacy_s6_p1: You may exercise the following rights at any time through your Dashboard or by contacting dewsecure9@gmail.com:
privacy_s6_p2: Access and export your account and subscription data; correct your email or device information; delete your account and associated data (during an active subscription period, certain data must be retained until the subscription ends); withdraw consent for non-essential data processing.
privacy_s7_p1: DewSecure is not intended for children under 13 (or such lower age as may be specified by your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware of any inadvertent collection, we will delete it as soon as possible.
privacy_s8_p1: Your data may be stored in Supabase and Cloudflare infrastructure located in Singapore, the United States, or the European Union. We ensure the lawfulness of cross-border transfers through Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or equivalent mechanisms.
privacy_s9_p1: We may update this Policy from time to time. Material changes will be announced on the official website or by email. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
privacy_s9_p2: This Policy is provided in multiple languages. In the event of any ambiguity or conflict between language versions, the English version shall prevail.
